lines.en: This is not me walking.
My legs carry me forward on their own.

lines.zh: 身体里有个声音在指挥。
lines.en: Something inside me is giving the orders.
My head tilts and my gait is unsteady.
The corner of my mouth lifts, and I cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 脚下像踩着别人的影子。
lines.en: I walk as if on someone else's shadow.
I did not choose this direction.
I try to stop; my feet will not.
This body still knows the way.
I hear myself laughing.

lines.zh: 眼里映出的天，颜色不对。
lines.en: The sky in my eyes is the wrong colour.
Quiet. He is thinking.
One heartbeat, one count.
My fingers twitch without permission.
These hands are this body's, and they are small.
I try to make a fist and cannot.
He is listening, and so am I.
This head feels very heavy.
I have been looking up for a long time.

lines.zh: 气在体内转，不是我的走向。
lines.en: The ki in me flows the wrong way.
A sentence is stuck in my throat.
He laughs, and my mouth follows.
This body is still warm.
I shivered once.
I know you are watching.
He has your face now.
Stay back; I cannot hold him.
Something is swimming in my eyes.
Have you come to save me?

lines.zh: 他已经在这具身体里了。
lines.en: He is already inside this body.
My voice does not sound like mine.
Can you hear me speak?
He wants to know your name.

lines.zh: 我眨了两次眼，一次是我的。
lines.en: I blinked twice. One of those was me.
Do not trust the look on my face.
Do you want to be chosen too?
My hand rises, and it was not my idea.
You are backing away; I can see it.
This body is stronger than you think.
Both of us are looking at you.
Say nothing. Just listen.
Baby will remember your scent.
It hurts, and he feels it too.
I stole a breath while I could.
The body swayed.
That blow woke me up a little.
The blood is red. I saw it.
His grip loosened for a moment.
Stop hitting; I am still in here.
This pain is his, and also mine.
I laughed, and it was not my idea.
I can still stand. That is enough.
Food? This body is hungry.
I want a bite too.
Two hungers, one mouth.
Bring it over. I will not be polite.
He does not understand this taste.
My hand reaches out and will not come back.
Once I eat, he settles deeper.
Eat first, talk later.

lines.zh: 这味道，让我安静了一会儿。
lines.en: This taste quiets me for a moment.
Enough. Stop teasing me with it.
The body lunged on its own.
I did not mean to hit you.
That one was mine.
I hit harder than you did.

lines.zh: 被弹开的瞬间，我听见笑声。
lines.en: As you bounce off, I hear laughter.
The shadows got trampled.
Steady. Do not fall.
We are not used to holding back.
Again, and I will go easy.
Do not come near this body.
He is not me. Hear that.
Help me hold my hand down.
He wants company too.

lines.zh: 我喊不出声，只能看着你。
lines.en: I cannot call out; I can only look at you.
Leave. Farther is better.

lines.zh: 这一具身体撑不了多久。
lines.en: This body will not last long.

lines.zh: 如果我不认得你了，就跑。
lines.en: If I stop knowing you, run.
I remember what you said.

lines.zh: 别相信夜里听到的声音。
lines.en: Do not trust the voices you hear at night.
I pick it up, then drop it.
My hand reaches out by itself.
He wants this one.
I am not sure what this is.
Picked up is picked up.
I grip it until my knuckles whiten.
My knuckles are trembling.
I smell what is on it.
Hide it before he sees.
I am still lucid enough for this.
He has chosen you.

lines.zh: 你身上有他喜欢的气息。
lines.en: You have a scent he likes.
I am still here, but only barely.
Run now. Do not look back.
The body has started moving.
I am not the one coming for you.
He is laughing, quietly.
This body is fast.
I am counting how many steps are left.
Three left.
Only two left.
You have no time left.
We have our eyes on you.

lines.zh: 这身体的气，比他原来的强。
lines.en: This body's ki is stronger than his own.
Now, leave it to me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，脚不是我的。
lines.en: I follow you on feet that are not mine.
Not one step behind.
The more you panic, the happier he is.
This body can fly.
I am knocking on the walls inside.
He hunts with great patience.
Spinning will not save you.
I can feel your fear.
You cannot outrun this on legs.
A few more blocks closer.
He is waiting for you to turn around.

lines.zh: 这具身体的极限，还没到。
lines.en: This body has not reached its limit.
I tried to fight it. It did not work.
I remember the back of you.
Just the last few steps.
Do not look in my eyes.
He will come at you from the side.
I will try to slow him down.
That punch was not mine.
I cannot pull back.
The combo chains on and on.
The ki in my palm burst.
The kick slides you away.
I hear the sound of bone.
He is laughing inside.
I yelled for you to dodge, and you did not hear.
The ki blasts skim the ground.
I am truly sorry.
This body strikes very accurately.
Your left shoulder is open.
I missed by a fraction.
That one was meant.
Again, and I will hold him back.
The pain is mine, not yours.
I come down out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 这孩子身上，多了个房客。
lines.en: This boy has a new tenant.
The way I land is not quite natural.
I look up, and my eyes are the wrong colour.
He does not like being seen.
I stand here like a misprint.
A mission set me loose.

lines.zh: 这具身体，借我用一会儿。
lines.en: I will borrow this body a while.
The breathing you hear is two people's.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，掌心上有个影子。
lines.en: Something moves in my palm.
Stay right there.
From today, he is in charge.
I am not entirely eaten yet.
The ground is cold; this body is not used to it.
A voice keeps talking and laughing.
I am here, and not entirely myself.

lines.zh: 这具身体，我会还回去的。
lines.en: I will give this body back. Someday.
Hot. Even this body can feel heat.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我听见他咒骂。
lines.en: I hit the ground and hear him curse.
Underwater, he is holding his breath too.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡嗡响，他听不清了。
lines.en: My ears ring, and he cannot hear.
Something has pierced in.
This force is competing with me.
Hunger has quieted even him.
A flash, and I saw a way out.
There is no echo here, and he is rattled.
